landing.headline: Where did all the money go? Now you'll know.
landing.lead: Expense Tracker keeps the house, the car, the groceries and every recurring bill in one tidy place, so the end of the month stops being a mystery novel.
landing.f.track.title: House & car, sorted
landing.f.track.text: Electricity, water, fuel, tires, that suspicious car wash. Log it in seconds and watch it land in the right box.
landing.f.receipts.title: Receipts that type themselves
landing.f.receipts.text: Snap a grocery receipt and AI reads every line: products, prices, discounts, store. You just nod and save.
landing.f.bills.title: Bills that nag (politely)
landing.f.bills.text: Internet, TV, insurance: get an email before they're due and keep getting one until you pay. No more late fees.
landing.f.year.title: Your year at a glance
landing.f.year.text: How this year compares with last, where the biggest chunk goes and what's coming up next, all on one page.
landing.f.backfill.title: Catch up in one go
landing.f.backfill.text: Forgot to log Internet for a year? Add every month in one step; months you already have are skipped.
landing.f.anywhere.title: Anywhere, any language
landing.f.anywhere.text: Works on your phone and your desktop, in light or dark, in English or Bulgarian.
landing.preview.title: A home page that actually tells you something
landing.preview.text: Totals for the year, a nudge about the bills that are next, and twelve little bars that say more than any spreadsheet.
landing.steps.title: Up and running in three steps
landing.step1.title: Create an account
landing.step1.text: A username and a password. That's it, no forms about your hobbies.
landing.step2.title: Add what you pay
landing.step2.text: Type an expense, scan a receipt or backfill a whole year of Internet in one go.
landing.step3.title: Know where it goes
landing.step3.text: Check the home page, open a chart, get reminded before bills are due.

landing.cta.title: Ready to meet your money?
landing.cta.text: It's free, it's yours, and it never judges the takeaway budget.
